decisions.gated4_32x32_k64: reject: slower isolated kernel and full encode
decisions.gated4_32x32_wide_k64: defer: repeatable sub-1-percent full encode gain on selected cases; pipeline-capability fallback and broader qualification remain unimplemented

ratio_conventions.candidate_speedup: old latency / candidate latency; >1 favors candidate
ratio_conventions.mlx_ratio: Tessery latency / MLX latency; <1 favors Tessery

intrusive_profile.limitations: One encoder per dispatch; calibration and encoder costs perturb timing. Normal-path timings are separate. Counter storage excluded from runtime buffer counters.

individual_projection_comparison.scope: first-layer resident matmul only; real weights, synthetic F32 activations; no bias, activation, full-model graph or readback in timing
individual_projection_comparison.conditions: isolated T/M/M/T processes; reversed case order for second pair; identical-operation A/B controls; per-invocation synchronization; uncontrolled thermals and background activity

tile-first.conditions: 20 calls/100ms minimum warmup; randomized paired order; baseline A/B identical; GPU time per current16/candidate32 fused gate/up/SiLU; host validation outside timing; uncontrolled thermals

tile-both.conditions: 20 calls/100ms minimum warmup; randomized paired order; baseline A/B identical; GPU time per current16/candidate32 fused gate/up/SiLU; host validation outside timing; uncontrolled thermals

model-first.conditions: Fixed independent plans; old shader baseline; all label permutations; >=1s warmup per label; sequential GPU; uncontrolled thermals

symmetric-first.conditions: Fixed independent plans; old shader baseline; two labels per resident model; all label permutations; >=1s warmup per label; sequential GPU; uncontrolled thermals

symmetric-repeat.conditions: Fixed independent plans; old shader baseline; two labels per resident model; all label permutations; >=1s warmup per label; sequential GPU; uncontrolled thermals
